rule.title: Public burn(address, uint256) allows anyone to destroy tokens from any holder

intent.attack_thesis: The token contract exposes a burn(address, uint256) or burnFrom(address, uint256) function that is callable by anyone without requiring msg.sender == address or an allowance check. An attacker calls burn(LP_pair, amount) to destroy LP tokens, manipulating the AMM price ratio, then swaps to extract the arbitrage profit.

reporting.title_template: Public burn function allows arbitrary token destruction — LP drain possible
reporting.summary: Matches token contracts exposing burn(address, uint256) or burnFrom(address, uint256) without msg.sender validation or allowance check, enabling anyone to destroy tokens held by any address.
reporting.user_summary: This token has a burn function that accepts an arbitrary address parameter and destroys that address's tokens without checking msg.sender or allowances. An attacker can burn LP pair reserves to manipulate the AMM price and drain liquidity.
reporting.technical_summary: The detector identifies ERC-20 tokens with a public burn(address,uint256) selector (0x9dc29fac) or burnFrom(address,uint256) selector (0x79cc6790) that lacks a msg.sender == address check or ERC-20 allowance verification. Without these guards, any caller can reduce any holder's balance. The primary exploit path is burning the LP pair's token balance to skew reserves, then swapping against the manipulated price to extract value.
reporting.exploit_narrative: The attacker identifies a DEX LP pair holding the vulnerable token. They call burn(LP_pair_address, large_amount) which destroys the pair's token reserves without touching the other side. The K-invariant is now broken — the token price appears much higher. The attacker swaps a small amount of the token for a disproportionate amount of the quote asset (USDT/WBNB/WETH), draining the LP.
exploit_preconditions: token exposes burn(address, uint256) without auth/allowance checks
DEX liquidity pair exists holding the vulnerable token
attacker holds or can acquire some of the token to swap after burning
remediation_hints: require msg.sender == account OR sufficient allowance before burning
restrict burn to onlyOwner if burning from arbitrary addresses is intentional

preconditions: no msg.sender or allowance check on the address parameter

steps.action: call burn(LP_pair_address, pair_balance) to destroy the pair's token reserves
steps.expected_state: pair reserves skewed — token reserves near zero, quote asset reserves unchanged

steps.action: swap a small token amount into the pair for disproportionate quote asset output
steps.expected_state: attacker receives large amount of quote asset at manipulated price

witness_goal.success_condition: attacker profits from price manipulation caused by unauthorized token burn
environment_requirements: DEX LP pair with token reserves
